reduction_formula: Eight +0 FP32 accumulators. Accumulator j receives products j,j+8,...,j+632 in order with FP32 round-to-nearest-even. Merge corresponding halves at widths4,2,1 with FP32 RNE, then BF16 RNE. BF16 products are exact normal FP32 values or signed zero within the declared domain.
prediction_implementation: NumPy integer arrays and integer shifts/masks/addition/subtraction only; floating-point NumPy exploratory results were not used as independent predictions.
domain: Normal finite BF16 inputs or signed zero; normal finite FP32 products/carries or signed zero. Reject nonfinite/subnormal operands, unsupported underflow and overflow instead of a framework fallback.
synthetic_row_mapping: Bank row j modulo512 repeated to the full262144-row projection shape.
scope: Bounded projection-component conformance with repeated-row synthetic matrices. The baseline hidden state is reused, not freshly recomputed here. Kernel symbols are observed launch provenance, not hardware reduction-order proof.
